arguments.name: Mira
arguments.phone: nine eight seven Seven six five. Four five six seven eight.

message: 'nine eight seven Seven six five. Four five six seven eight.' is not a 10-digit phone number.
reply: I couldn’t save that number because it wasn’t recognized as 10 digits. Please say the 10 digits again, one at a time.
reason: It explained that the number wasn’t recognized as 10 digits and asked the caller to repeat it.
